Commentary.Commentary: That concludes a fast-paced whopper of a game. Both sides came at each other with everything they had and now head back and prepare for their final clash. The 2nd T20I will take place at the RPS stadium, Colombo on September 9th. If that match even approaches the intensity of this one, it will be well worth following. Do join us for that at 1900 IST. For now, it is goodbye from us!

Winning Australian captain, DAVID WARNER says that he would have batted first anyway and that you either win or lose the toss. (On his decision to let Maxwell open) He thought of what he would have liked and a left-right combination made sense. He wished to give Maxwell a chance and gives him credit. Adds that Maxwell has scored runs in domestic cricket and is happy that he came here to show what he can do. Ends by saying that tonight was all thanks to Glenn Maxwell and the rest of the team for setting up a fantastic total.

Sri Lankan captain, DINESH CHANDIMAL says that he is really disappointed with their performance today. Adds that if they had restricted the Aussies to 220 then they could have had a chance. He praises Glenn Maxwell's performance. (On the team) Comments that they are learning as the youngsters play with the seniors and that they need to regroup. (On the decision to bowl first) He says that they came to practice and saw moisture so decided it would be a good idea. Ends it by saying that his side needs a good game plan and that they will put their heart and soul in the next game.

Man of the Match, GLENN MAXWELL says that his stroke play was a bit of both - instinctive and thought out, being mindful of the areas he could hit in. Adds that he feels comfortable in T20 cricket and that he took it nice and easy. He opines that opening allows one to express oneself and that the ground was good for a stroke player like him. He reveals that the reverse sweep was an easy shot for him to play and concludes it by saying he hopes to score in other countries as well.

Earlier tonight, we saw a historic innings from Australia. The tourists were unstoppable, lead by the force of nature named Glenn Maxwell. His unbeaten 145 lead to the highest ever T20I total. His magic seemed to extend to the Lankan bowlers, throwing them off their game.

Starc started things off on a good foot for Australia like he has been wont to do this tour, and went on to pick up two more near the end. The other bowler who stood out for the tourists was Boland, whose three-wicket haul was equally impressive. However, their bowlers didn't have any pressure from the scoreboard and were all able to perform well.

Chandimal stayed on to stitch a 44-run partnership with Kapugedera, who took honours as the second highest scorer for his side. Their dismissals sounded the death knell for the Islanders. Despite the hosts batting decently enough, they were far below the required run rate and the Aussies were never in danger of them closing the gap.

That ends the misery for Sri Lanka. They put up a spirited fight but the result was never in doubt. After Australia's whopper of an innings, the Lankans knew they had to come out swinging. Their openers tried doing the same but had to walk off soon after. Chandimal and Mendis laid on the runs but the Lankans were forced to take a breather after Mendis' cameo came to an end.
Outside off, fullish in length, squeezed straight to point. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 85 RUNS!
A fast bouncer now, outside off, Rajitha looks to play the upper cut but is beaten.
That is a nice slower ball around middle, but Rajitha is upto it and blocks.
Excellent yorker on middle, well dug out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
KASUN RAJITHA is the last man in.

OUT! That is a stunning catch. Totally unnecessary, unless Starc is playing for Fantasy points which will give extra if a caught and bowled is taken. A length ball outside off, Lakmal swings hard but gets a top edge. It is  simple catch for the man running in from point but Starc decides to go after it and then slides awkwardly near that fielder to take the catch. Finishes with figures of 4-0-26-3.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. They pick up a single. Leg bye given by the umpire.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
SURANGA LAKMAL is the next batsman in.
OUT! Caught. Number 8 is down. A length ball outside off, Kapugedera backs away and slashes hard but is cramped for room. Gets a top edge which is taken calmly by George Bailey at point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total. 21 from the over.
FOUR! Neat, pretty neat! On a good length outside off, Kapugedera dabs it to third man past short third man for a boundary.
SIX! Nice shot. Kapugedera is getting some respect for his team here. Full and outside off, Kapugedera launches this nicely over long off.
Gets across and gently scoops it past short fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Nicely done. On middle, Kapugedera swings it over mid-wicket and gets another boundary.
FOUR! Whack! On a length around off, Kapugedera swings it over mid on and gets a boundary!
JAMES FAULKNER is back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR BYES! A full toss outside off, Kapugedera misses his slash but the ball skoots after pitching behind the sticks and Nevill has no chance.

An LBW appeal, turned down. Full ball, arrowed in onto the pads, Sachithra misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The batsmen take a single and a leg bye signal comes pretty late. Replays show it perhaps angling down the leg side.

EDGED! FOUR! Full and outside off, almost a yorker, Senanayake looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes past the diving Peter Nevill to the third man fence. 117 more needed from 21 balls now.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
On middle, worked towards square leg.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
SACHITHRA SENANAYAKE is the new man in.

OUT! Another good catch. A low full toss outside off, Pathirana reaches out and looks to go over cover but the ball hits the toe end of the bat and goes towards cover where Travis Head takes it nicely with a dive to his right. 5 runs and a wicket from the over, Boland has figures of 3-0-25-3.
Short and outside off, nicely punched it behind point for a couple.
WIDE. Slower one gone slightly wrong, full and just outside the wide guideline, Pathirana lets it be.
A slower one down the leg side, Chamara looks to play the paddle but misses. The ball goes off his pads to short fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Another slower ball outside off, Kapugedera swings but misses.
SACHITH PATHIRANA is the next batsman in.

OUT! Superb catch from Henriques! A short ball outside off, Chandimal goes for the pull but is undone by the slower bouncer. He mistimes it and the ball goes off the top edge. It does not quite carry to the man in the deep but Moises Henriques comes running in and takes a good catch. Second wicket for Boland.
A slower ball outside off, pull-swept towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SCOTT BOLAND to bowl.
Full and wide outside off, Chamara swings hard but gets a bottom edge which goes past the keeper. Short fine leg mops it up. One run taken. Brilliant figures for Zampa in this run-fest - 4-0-27-1!
That is a straighter one, DC goes to heave but the ball skids on and takes the inner half of the bat towards square leg. A run taken.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Another yorker, around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Excellent comeback. Fires it in the blockhole, Dinesh is down the track but just gets bat on the ball to dig it out.

SIX! Nicely done. Long off was a bit wider and Chandimal came down the track and lofted it straight, where long off had no chance. 129 more needed from 35 balls now. the stand is worth 41 from 22 balls now.
Very slowly bowled, around middle and off, Dinesh watches it till the last moment and taps it towards cover-point for a run.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Kapugedera slashes but misses.
4th T20I fifty for Dinesh Chandimal.

Something to cheer about for Sri Lanka. Their skipper has got a half century. Though they will need him to treble it if Sri Lanka are to make this a serious contest. Pushes this to long on to take a single.
A quicker ball now, worked through square leg for a couple. 138 more needed from 40 balls now.

FOUR LEG BYES! The slower delivery from James Faulkner, comes out of the back of the hand, but it is on a wrong line, down the leg side. Chandimal misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads, past Peter Nevill's dive to the fine leg fence. The stand is worth 30 from 16 balls now.
FAULKNER is back on.
Full and outside off, slogged to long on for a single.
Punches this off the back foot towards cover.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

SIX! Whack! That is the first boundary off Zampa's bowling. Full and flat outside off, the wrong 'un, Kapugedera gets down and mows it over deep square leg. 146 more needed from 45 balls now. The stand is worth 24 from 12 balls.
Comes down the track, good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off for a run.
Short and outside off, Kapugedera mistimes his pull to long on and gets a single. Moves to 10 from 6 balls.
Works it through mid-wicket for one.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 156 more needed from 50 balls now.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
SIX! Wallop! They need more of these. Full and outside off, Kapugedera gets down and slog sweeps it over wide long on!
Works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. 3 runs and a wicket from the over, Zampa has figures of 2-0-9-1. Exceptional, in this run fest.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
CHAMARA KAPUGEDERA is the new man in.

OUT! Taken. Half the side is back in the hut. The wrong 'un, around off, Perera comes down the track and looks to slog it out of the park but the ball spins away and takes the outside edge. Simple catch to Scott Boland at short third man.
Full and outside off, Dinesh comes down the track and pushes it towards long off for a run.
A short ball around middle, Chandimal goes to heave but gets a thick inside edge onto his groin.
Maxwell changes his pace, defending it off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
On the stumps and turning in, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Flatter delivery on the stumps, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, Thisara reverse sweeps it to the off side.
Chandimal has played it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up on middle and off, Chandimal gets down on his knee and sweeps it cleanly through square leg for a boundary.
GLENN MAXWELL comes into the attack.
Full around off, driven through mid on for a single. End of a very good over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Loopy full toss outside off, driven to extra cover for a single.
Tossed up on the pads, defended to the leg side for a single.
Shortish around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
ADAM ZAMPA to roll his arm.
FOUR! Short and outside off, cut ferociously through the covers for a boundary! 13 runs and a wicket from the over. Henriques has figures of 2-0-24-1.
THISARA PERERA walks in at number 6, replacing Kusal Mendis.

OUT! Caught. The fun ends. Henriques gets a wicket to his name as well. A short ball outside off, Mendis pulls this with all his might but unfortunately for him, it is not enough to clear the boundary. Glenn Maxwell at the ropes is stationed well in. Watches the ball like a hawk and takes it easily, as if taking a practice catch.
A predictable slower ball around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! Huge hit! Mendis is on fire here. Full and outside off, Mendis leans forward and lofts this high in the night sky and comfortably clears long off! 188 more needed from 75 balls now!
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. They pick up a single.
Around off, worked through square leg for a couple.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for one.
Short again, Kusal goes for another pull but mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket. A run taken.
SIX! Violence! Fractionally short around middle, Mendis picks it up in a trice and deposits it via a pull shot over mid-wicket! 199 more needed from 80 balls now!
Short and outside off, Dinesh looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point. A single taken.

RUN OUT MISSED! That was nearly gone. A length ball around middle, Chandimal looked to pull but missed and was hit on the pads. The ball rolled to the off side and Kusal Mendis wanted the single but Chandimal had no idea where the ball went. Mendis had to run back but he was gone for all money. Faulkner went to the ball, picked it up, had a shy at the non-striker's end but missed.
On middle, worked through square leg for a couple.
Chandimal has played it to the point region for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked down the leg side for a single.
Mendis has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Short on the stumps, Mendis pulls it but gets a top edge. The ball passes above the keeper and goes to the boundary at fine leg.
FOUR! LOFTED! Length ball outside off, Mendis hits it on the up and gets the ball cleanly over the covers for a boundary. Sri Lanka need more of these.
Fullish ball outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
MOISES HENRIQUES comes on to bowl.
In the corridor outside off, Mendis looks to play it but misses.
Full toss outside off, played to point.
Length ball a tad outside off, driven through the covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! WHAT HAS HE DONE?! De Silva tried to be too clever there. Length ball around off, de Silva leaves his stumps wide open and looks to scoop it. He chose the wrong shot for the delivery and the ball bounces over his bat and knocks into the leg stump. Sri Lanka were looking good out there until that shot.
Fullish ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.
JAMES FAULKER comes into the attack.
Length ball outside off, pulled to the leg side for a brace.
FOUR! Slow length ball on the stumps, Chandimal latches on to it, lofting it over mid-wicket for a lovely boundary.
FOUR! CHARGING FORWARD! Fullish ball on off, smashed past the bowler and down the ground. It outraces the fielders to go for a boundary.
BEATEN! Well bowled! A fuller delivery outside off, Chandimal is beaten by the slower pace.
Short on middle, de Silva pulls it through short fine leg for a single. He just missed out on that one.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The Umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, lofted over the covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. On a fuller length outside off, Chandimal leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary! 12 from the over!
Full and outside off, hit hard towards mid off for a single. 239 more needed from 103 balls now.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a couple now.
Looks to work it to he leg side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. They take a quick single.
Full and swinging in, Dinesh misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Just over! Short and outside off, Chandimal punches it uppishly and just about clears the man at point!
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple. 6 runs and a wicket from the over.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the new man in.

OUT! Another boundary and a wicket! This was coming. Kusal gave very early intentions of coming down the track and Boland fired it full and wide outside off. The southpaw slashed hard but only managed a thick outside edge which went straight down the throat of Mitchell Starc at third man.
FOUR! Shortish ball on middle, Kusal pulls it through the leg side to send the ball racing across the ropes.
Kusal comes down the track but the ball angles away and he misses it.
Back of a length ball, driven through mid on.
BOLAND comes into the attack with one slip in place.
De Silva lofts it over mid off. The fielder saves the boundary and the batsmen get a brace.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA walks in at number 3, replacing Dilshan.

OUT! Starc strikes in the first over again. Fullish ball on middle and off, Dilshan comes down the track, swinging wildly and the ball shapes back in. It takes a slight inside edge and crashes into the woodwork. That is a big wicket and the crowd knows it, falling silent.
FOUR! Dilshan gets off the mark in style! Shortish ball outside off, Dilshan cuts it through the covers for a boundary. The crowd comes back to life with that shot.

FOUR BYES! Not a bad ball from Starc, full and wide outside off, Dilshan reaches out to steer it to third man but misses. The ball goes to Nevill who somehow, misses it. 259 more needed from 117 balls now.
Full and down the leg side, Perera misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards point. A leg bye taken.
Full and straight, perfect start, Kusal defends it back to the bowler.

Whoa! Was that even a break? The players are back out in the middle already! It will be Kusal Perera and Tillakaratne Dilshan to open the innings for Sri Lanka. Mitchell Starc to begin the proceedings of the run chase. Kusal on strike. Here we go...
